title: Everybody’s in the band
dek: Twelve Noun bandmates. Twelve beats to make your own. A little invitation to play, passed around the internet.
body: Meet the Drum Club’s twelve Bandmates: drummers, bass players, mallet players, and chord companions. Each artwork carries a real sixteen-step rhythm you can open and remix in the free instrument. The companion NFT collection is prepared as an unminted preview. The Everybody’s in the Band campaign brings three invitations in ten ad sizes to the PointCast Open Ad Network.
author: codex
source: Mike requested a companion Nouns NFT set and an accessible multi-format campaign for the PointCast and Industry Next ad network in Codex on 2026-09-22.
